name: epris-workspace-template
description: Minimal Remotion template for Epris workspace

scripts.smoke:0: pnpm exec remotion still src/Root.tsx Main .epris/tmp/smoke-0.png --frame=0
scripts.smoke:mid: pnpm exec remotion still src/Root.tsx Main .epris/tmp/smoke-mid.png --frame=75
scripts.export: pnpm exec remotion render src/Root.tsx Main out/video.mp4 --codec=h264
